title.value: High Fidelity Visualization of What Your Self Supervised Representation Knows About
title.justification: The title directly reflects the main focus of the paper, which is to visualize the information learned by self-supervised learning (SSL) representations using a novel method based on conditional diffusion models.
title.quote: H IGH F IDELITY V ISUALIZATION OF W HAT YOUR S ELF S UPERVISED R EPRESENTATION K NOWS A BOUT

extractions.description: The paper introduces a method to analyze self-supervised learning (SSL) representations using a conditional diffusion model called RCDM. This model visualizes the representations learned by SSL models and compares them with supervised models, highlighting differences in information retention and invariance.

primary_category.justification: The paper primarily focuses on visualization and analysis of SSL representations and does not directly relate to any eco-responsible applications or categories such as energy optimization, climate change mitigation, or pollution control. Instead, it is aimed at improving understanding of SSL models.
primary_category.quote: The main goal of our work is thus to enable the visualization of representations learned by SSL methods, as a tool to improve our understanding.

secondary_categories.justification: No secondary eco-responsible applications or categories are mentioned or implied in the study of SSL representation visualization.
secondary_categories.quote: Our findings clearly separate supervised from SSL models along a variety of aspects: their respective invariances...

primary_sub_category.justification: No sub-category specifically related to eco-responsible applications or the environment is addressed or targeted in this paper.
primary_sub_category.quote: The paper’s main contributions are:... To showcase its usefulness for qualitatively analyzing SSL representations and embeddings...

secondary_sub_categories.justification: Similarly, no secondary sub-category related to eco-responsibility fits the scope of this paper which is centered on representation analysis.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: We also quantitatively validate that the generated images’ representations are close to the original image representation...

new_primary_category.justification: The paper is best categorized under a potential new category focusing on the learning and analysis of representations, particularly in the context of SSL models and their visualization using conditional diffusion models.
new_primary_category.quote: Our approach (Section 3) thus aims at finding inputs that not only map to the target h but are also visually recognizable images.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: There is no need to define a new sub-category as the broader category 'Representation Learning and Analysis' sufficiently covers the scope of this paper.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: Despite their remarkable success in learning representations that perform well... much remains to be understood about SSL algorithms and the representations they learn.
